title: Coffee Shop Social Media Marketing: Build Your Following | Bellwether Coffee

facts.fact: Instagram is listed as requiring about 30 minutes per day of time investment for a coffee shop.
facts.quote: | Instagram | Visual brand, local discovery | All ages, broad reach | 30 min/day |

facts.fact: TikTok is listed as requiring about 1 hour per day of time investment for a coffee shop.
facts.quote: | TikTok | Growth, younger audience | 18–34 primarily | 1 hour/day |

facts.fact: Facebook is listed as requiring about 15 minutes per day of time investment for a coffee shop.
facts.quote: | Facebook | Local community, events | 30+ skewing older | 15 min/day |

facts.fact: Google Business is listed as requiring about 5 minutes per day of time investment for a coffee shop.
facts.quote: | Google Business | Local search, reviews | Anyone searching | 5 min/day |

facts.fact: The guide sets a goal engagement rate of 3–6% on Instagram.
facts.quote: | Engagement rate | Content resonance | 3–6% on Instagram |

facts.fact: The guide recommends dedicating 2–3 hours weekly to shooting and writing content.
facts.quote: dedicate 2–3 hours weekly for shooting and writing

facts.fact: The guide says daily social media commitment for Stories and engagement can stay around 15–20 minutes.
facts.quote: Daily commitment can stay around 15–20 minutes for Stories and engagement

facts.fact: The guide states that social media takes 6–12 months of consistency before compounding really kicks in.
facts.quote: Social media takes 6–12 months of consistency before compounding really kicks in.

facts.fact: The vendor claims roasting in-house can save a coffee shop $1,000–5,000 per month on coffee costs.
The vendor claims a wholesaler takes 67% of the margin on every pound of coffee.
facts.quote: Your wholesaler takes 67% of the margin on every pound

facts.fact: The FAQ recommends a coffee shop post three to five feed posts per week on Instagram, plus daily Stories.
facts.quote: Three to five feed posts per week, daily Stories.

facts.fact: Bellwether Coffee's guidance recommends using 5–15 relevant hashtags per social media post.
Bellwether Coffee advises planning 3–4 hours weekly for social media content creation and scheduling.
facts.quote: Plan 3–4 hours weekly for content creation and scheduling.

facts.fact: Bellwether Coffee advises adding 15–20 minutes daily for Stories and engagement on social media.
facts.quote: Add 15–20 minutes daily for Stories and engagement.

facts.fact: Bellwether Coffee estimates a total social media time commitment of 5–7 hours per week for an active presence on 1–2 platforms.
facts.quote: Total: 5–7 hours per week for active presence on 1–2 platforms.

facts.fact: Bellwether Coffee suggests TikTok is worth using if the target customer is under 35, citing significant organic reach for authentic content.
facts.quote: If you're targeting customers under 35, yes.
